messages:
tara: Heads-up: change window tonight 23:00 UTC. Need exemption to push a small routing fix + embed cache tweak (model-service v3.5.0). Low risk but touches cache keys.

sre-lead: Please post rollback steps and canary plan. Need auto-fail triggers.

tara: Rollback: pin v3.4.9 and redeploy (`/deploy model-service --image v3.4.9 --pin`). Cache rollback script ready (`scripts/emb_cache_restore.sh`). Canary: 2% -> 20% -> 100%. 10m hold at 20%.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Preflight OK. No active incidents. Command: `/deploy model-service --image v3.5.0-embedcache --pin --canary 2%`.

alex: Add p99 latency and kv_miss_rate alerts. If p99 > baseline +1.5s for 2 windows or kv_miss > 3% auto-fail.

pm-raul: Approve so long as SRE + ops are watching during window.

sre-lead: Approval: +1. I'll be on watch. Auto-unpin on trigger configured.

tara: Running canary now 23:02 UTC. Canary ID cb-700000.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: cb-700000 at 2% healthy. Advancing to 20% in 8m.

alex: Dashboards green so far. Synthetic hits every 30s.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: 20% hold complete, metrics within thresholds. Rolling to 100% now.

sre-lead: Roll complete at 23:27 UTC. No anomalies. Closing exemption.
